reason: The raw candidates provide information about the rifle used in the assassination but do not directly link to the Ruth Paine Home or the night of November 21st. A bridge note can connect the rifle to Oswald's stay at the Paine home, and a verification note can confirm the rifle type.

derived_candidates.text: The rifle used in the assassination is linked to Lee Harvey Oswald, who spent the night at the Ruth Paine Home on November 21st, 1963.
The official rifle is a 6.5×52mm Carcano Model 91/38 infantry rifle, as accepted in the investigation.
